question: An adversary alters files in a shared location by inserting malicious programs, scripts, or exploit code into otherwise legitimate content, so it executes when a user opens it. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique corresponds to this behavior, and why does it map?
answer:
- T1080.
- T1080 corresponds to tainting shared content, mapping CAPEC-562: modifying shared files to trigger malicious execution when opened.
